name: firefly-mcp
description: Read, categorise and manage your own Firefly III instance — 152 operations behind 5 scoped tools.
long_description: Connects Claude to your self-hosted Firefly III with your own Personal Access Token. Reading, writing and deleting are three separate tools, every write can be previewed with dry_run, and filter-driven bulk writes require max_matches. There is no hosted backend: the server runs on your machine and talks only to your Firefly III instance (plus a once-a-day version check that carries no data).

firefly_api_url.title: Firefly III URL
firefly_api_url.description: Your Firefly III address: a bare domain such as firefly.example.com, or a full base URL including /api/v1.

firefly_api_token.title: Personal Access Token
firefly_api_token.description: Firefly III → Options → Profile → OAuth → Create New Personal Access Token.

tools.name: firefly_query
tools.description: Read from Firefly III. Never changes anything.

tools.name: firefly_mutate
tools.description: Create or change records. Does not delete anything.

tools.name: firefly_destructive
tools.description: Delete records, or rewrite one field across many records. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: firefly_list_operations
tools.description: List the available operations, optionally for one entity.

tools.name: firefly_get_schema
tools.description: Get the parameter schema of one operation.
